---
name: Something is wrong
about: A page shows the wrong thing, or the generator will not run
labels: bug
---

**What you saw and what you expected.** If it is a statement that reads wrong, give the declaration's name and
what the [Mathlib docs](https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/) show for it.

**Which bundle.** The home page footer names the Lean version, the commit and when it was generated. If you
generated it yourself, say so and give the command.

**If the generator failed**, paste the whole message. It should be one sentence; if it is a stack trace, that is
a separate bug and worth saying so.
